messages:
olivia_pm: Heads-up — Kickoff for ThermoSystems power/throughput validation next Wed 10am PST. Need kernel tuning plan, data schema, and checkpoints. @ajay_hw @maria_dev please align. Rough agenda: target workloads, perf/W metrics, smoke runs, data exchange format, and announcement cadence. Doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/thermo-kickoff
ajay_hw: On it. Can we get the vendor kernel patch diff + HW perf counters ahead of time? I'll need PCIe and PMU counters. I'll draft a probe list and kernel tuning stages.
maria_dev: I can prep the automation + evaluation harness. Can we agree to start with a qemu smoke, then hardware dry run? I'd like a sampleset: 10k tokens, seq=512 as the canonical smoke. Also can we standardize metric names to avoid later munging: tokens/s, watts_avg, p50, p95, p99.
sam_ops: We should reserve 2 dedicated lab nodes Tue-Fri for dry runs and thermal margin tests. Opening infra ticket INFRA-1123 to claim capacity and power meters. Also need to add power-capping step for controlled experiments.
ajay_hw: For kernel tuning, propose stages: baseline (stock kernel), kernel-inline-allocs, telemetry-led codepath, sparse-attention toggle. Need ability to flip the sparse_attention kernel at runtime. Sample run command for bench team: `sudo ./run_bench --model=redwood-3b --batch=4 --seq=512 --timing`
maria_dev: Automation job draft: ```yaml
name: thermo-smoke
nodes: 2
workload: gpt-like
samples: 10000
metrics: [tokens/s, watts_avg, p50, p95]
report_s3: s3://redwood-thermo/dryrun/1719876543/
```
I'll add a converter to produce CSV with those headers.
benchbot: Smoke run (prototype): baseline tokens/s=1200, watts_avg=420W, p50=85ms, p95=280ms. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-thermo/dryrun/1719876543/baseline.tar.gz
olivia_pm: Nice start. Reminder — initial public-facing numbers must be embargoed until we coordinate announcement with ThermoSystems and GTM. Looping in legal separately.
sam_ops: :thumbsup: Adding `embargo=true` tag to INFRA-1123 and to the artifacts bucket policy.
maria_dev: Can we define success criteria? I propose: perf/W improvement >= 10% after tuning and stable p95 < 300ms. Also need <0.5% regression on correctness evals.
ajay_hw: Agree. Add regression checks in kernel stage gates: run eval-set and ensure hallucination rate delta <= 0.5%. Also capture kernel chroot logs: `/var/log/kernel-tune.log`.
olivia_pm: Meeting invite sent for Wed 10am PST. Agenda + attachments in the kickoff doc. @maria_dev please invite Thermo lead and share pre-reads.
maria_dev: Done — invited thermo-lead@thermosys.com and attached sample traces and the automation job. Added owner checklist: 1) vendor patch + counters 2) node reservation 3) INA260 calibration 4) s3 bucket policy.
benchbot: Instrumentation reminder: INA260 calibration missing for node lab-02. Current status: calibration=NOT_CALIBRATED. Please onboard before dry run.
sam_ops: On it. I'll coordinate hw-tools and schedule calibration Monday morning.
olivia_pm: Also note we want to try two quant configs for cost-curve: q4_0 and q5_1. Maria — can you parameterize the automation to sweep quant configs?
maria_dev: Yep — will add quant sweep flag and produce side-by-side perf/W reports.
ajay_hw: One more ask: collect per-layer memory and KV cache growth to troubleshoot p95 spikes. Probe list will include: mem_peak, kv_cache_bytes, CPU steal, thermal_throttle_count.
olivia_pm: Great work. We'll sync after the first dry run. Keep embargo in mind for any slide assets. Thanks team.
